title: Julio Franco Diamond Kings 1988 Donruss #10 Cleveland Indians
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a vintage 1988 Donruss Diamond Kings trading card featuring Julio Franco of the Cleveland Indians. The card is an original 1988 release from Donruss and is part of the Diamond Kings subset. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is not autographed. It is an insert card with the card number 10 in the set.
